text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-alert: sustained GPU memory pressure detected in pool=infra-infer-w2. metric=gpu.mem.used_pct breached 90% over 4 samples. heuristic=kv-prefetch-frag. PagerDuty INC-9017 created. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure

pagerduty: PagerDuty: [P1] GPU mem pressure (infra-infer-w2). Paging eng-oncall. Please acknowledge and follow triage steps.

sam: ack. hopping on it; taking lead. collecting affected nodes and tenants. will micro-update in 2m. @leah @cheng please standby.

leah: on the dashboard I see kvcache evict spikes and prefetch throughput doubling. likely prefetch-driven fragmentation + concurrent large-batch inferences. any recent rollout to the pool?

cheng: checking node health. ssh -> infer-node-07. quick `nvidia-smi` shows GPU0 mem used 15800/16384 MiB, multiple processes pinned.

cheng: logs: ```
2026-03-15T03:06:12Z infer-node-07 kvcache: prefetch request surge=+180%
2026-03-15T03:06:15Z infer-node-07 cuda:cuMemAlloc failed: out-of-memory
```

ops-runner: auto-shedder triggered for pool=infra-infer-w2; shed 18 low-priority sessions in last 45s. Prefetch throttle recommendation queued.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) reduce prefetch_factor on pool to 0.25 2) cordon one hot node for graceful drain 3) apply fallback routing for heavy batch routes -> lower-memory model 4) notify customers of transient errors

leah: applying prefetch throttle via control-plane: `{"pool":"infra-infer-w2","prefetch_factor":0.25}`. rolling now.

cheng: applied. watching metrics... prefetch rate dropping. now restarting infer-agent on infer-node-07 to clear ephemeral allocations: `sudo systemctl restart infer-agent`

cheng: after restart GPU usage dropped from ~96% -> ~70% on that host. cuda errors stopped.

incident-bot: Auto-mitigation: fallback-route applied for routes: /v1/infer/batch-long -> model=distil-bert-quant. Temporary mapping TTL=10m.

sam: cordoned infer-node-09 for drain: `redwoodctl node cordon infer-node-09 --reason "mem-pressure mitigation"`. pool utilization overall falling 94% -> 78%. autoscaler provisioning +1 node (ETA ~4m).

customer-support: affected tenants observed: ["delta-analytics","mosaic-ai"]. Impact: some batch jobs returned 503 or timed out between 03:05-03:08 UTC; interactive routes degraded latency briefly. Posting update to tenants now.

leah: suggestion: enable kvcache LIFO eviction to keep hot prefixes. toggled kvcache eviction policy to LIFO on pool infra-infer-w2. Monitoring.

ops-runner: kvcache-evictions dropped 60% post-policy change. no new cuMemAlloc errors in last 2 windows.

sam: update for PD: mitigated -> overall pool mem at 65-75%, prefetch back to steady-state, evictions normalized. Keeping incident open for 30m for monitoring. Owner for follow-up: leah.

customer-support: tenant notifications posted. no escalations received.

leah: follow-ups: reduce default prefetch_factor on all infer pools (leah), add alert threshold for sustained >85% without autoscale (sam), add CI job to simulate prefetch + fragmentation (cheng).

sam: thanks team. will close INC-9017 if stable for 30m. :thumbsup: 

pagerduty: INC-9017 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. No active alerts in the last 3 windows.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Tags: gpu-memory, prefetch, kvcache, auto-shed. Postmortem scheduled in #postmortems in 48h.
